ctnh.multiblock.demon_will_generator.shi: Raw difference (per type) = |side1−side2| only if sides differ and max(both sides) ≥ 5; otherwise 0
Effective difference = raw difference × (1 + 0.1×capacity levels) × (1 + 0.1×augmented levels); ×2 in specialty mode
EU/t = 256 × diversity × effective difference × ln(effective difference+1) × [doubt boost]
Doubt boost = 2 + 0.2×sacrifice levels (requires continuous doubt fluid input)
Diversity: per side 1.2−Σ(ratio²), then multiply both sides; 0.2 if a side has no will; 0.8 in specialty; up to ~1.44 when both sides are balanced
Will migration: high side −4% of difference, low side +4%; if high side <10 for that type, drain only (no transfer); if either side ≥999, clear all will on that side
Specialty mode processes one will type only; default mode sums concentration differences of all types
With linked soul network: LP per cycle = gross EU/t × min(1%, 0.1%+0.1%×orb levels); actual EU/t = gross × (1 − conversion fraction)
Displacement: per side drains 4×min(level×2, floor(raw/4)) raw will; each typed will gains +min(level×2, floor(raw/4))

ctnhmana.ponder.mystic_spire_scene1.head: Mystic Spire
ctnhmana.ponder.mystic_spire_scene1.text: Mystic Spire is used for remote magic power transmission
After shaping the structure, a delta spark will be generated at the top of the tower
Use the electronic spirit staff right-click the delta spark to bind two towers
The first one is set as the receiver
The second one is set as the sender
Shift right-click to cancel the binding
ctnhmana.ponder.mystic_spire_scene2.head: Mystic Spire's properties
ctnhmana.ponder.mystic_spire_scene2.text: Mystic Spire has four properties: capacity, output speed, receiving speed, range
Put the mystic spire upgrade in the main block UI to improve its properties
Capacity is the amount of magic power cached by the tower, initialized to 1000000, maximum is INT
Output speed determines the speed at which the tower actively outputs, initialized to 10000/tick, maximum not exceeding 1/10 of the capacity
Receiving speed determines the speed at which the tower absorbs magic power, initialized to 10000/tick
The absorption and production of magic power speed is 10% of the receiving speed, which can be boosted by the transposition rune, and the maximum value is taken
Range determines the effect range of the tower, initialized to 15, maximum is 50
ctnhmana.ponder.mystic_spire_scene3.head: Mystic Spire's mode
ctnhmana.ponder.mystic_spire_scene3.text: Mystic Spire has four working modes: focus, spark spread, condenser spread, transfer
In focus mode, the tower actively absorbs the magic power of nearby same-colored sparks or magic flowers
In spark spread mode, the tower actively outputs magic power to nearby same-colored sparks or magic condensers
In condenser spread mode, the tower only broadcasts mana to mana condensers within range
In transfer mode, the tower does not perform any operations, only implementing the transfer of magic power between towers
Note: Condenser spread does not transfer mana to pools, flowers, or ordinary sparks

ctnhmana.ponder.rune_ritual.header: How to finish the rune ritual
ctnhmana.ponder.rune_ritual.text_1: First, place the central rune holder.
ctnhmana.ponder.rune_ritual.text_2: Then place other rune holders at the positions shown in JEI.
ctnhmana.ponder.rune_ritual.text_3: Put the right item on the right position.
ctnhmana.ponder.rune_ritual.text_4: Then drop the ritual catalysts in the area.
ctnhmana.ponder.rune_ritual.text_5: Also prepare a wandering trader here for sacrifice.
ctnhmana.ponder.rune_ritual.text_6: Finally, make sure your mana ring has enough mana, then right-click the central rune holder.
ctnhmana.ponder.rune_ritual.text_7: If the dropped items disappear, the ritual has started successfully.
ctnhmana.ponder.rune_ritual.title: How to finish the rune ritual
